old_caption: The video showcases an intricate arrangement of dominoes set up on a wooden floor. The dominoes are meticulously arranged in a complex spiral pattern, with sections highlighted in green and blue to distinguish different paths or segments. The spiral design is symmetrical and appears to be part of a larger, elaborate structure. The background remains consistent throughout, focusing solely on the wooden floor and the domino setup, emphasizing the precision and detail of the arrangement. There are no visible characters or animals in the scene, and the camera maintains a steady overhead shot, capturing the entire layout without any noticeable movement or change in perspective.
original_wisa_caption: The video showcases an intricate arrangement of dominoes set up on a wooden floor. The dominoes are meticulously arranged in a complex spiral pattern, with sections highlighted in green and blue to distinguish different paths or segments. The spiral design is symmetrical and appears to be part of a larger, elaborate structure. As the video progresses, a hand holding a small tool enters from the left side of the frame, carefully placing additional dominoes at the beginning of the spiral. This action suggests preparation for a chain reaction where the dominoes will be set off one after another. The background remains consistent throughout, focusing solely on the wooden floor and the domino setup, emphasizing the precision and detail of the arrangement. There are no visible characters or animals in the scene, and the camera maintains a steady overhead shot, capturing the entire layout without any noticeable movement or change in perspective.
caption: The video showcases a top-down view of a wooden floor holding a large spiral of dominoes, with an inner loop of green and blue pieces and a longer outer loop of white pieces. A separate, already-flattened chain of white dominoes lies off to the left, and a short stretch of the outer loop's left side is already down at the opening of the excerpt. The collapse is already underway, and its leading edge travels steadily along the outer ring, sweeping across the bottom and climbing up the right side toward the upper-right. Each upright white domino ahead of the front stands in a row with visible gaps, and once the front passes it settles into a continuous pale line. The inner green and blue spiral stays upright and untouched throughout the excerpt. The left-side chain shows no further change, remaining in its flattened state. The camera and the wood-grain background stay fixed, so all visible motion belongs to the propagating domino front.

infer a physical error from their mismatch, or manufacture continuity across a visible edit.
Use the chronological video as primary evidence. The independent visual notes are fallible aids,
not ground truth. Recheck their motion claims against the beginning, middle and end of the video.
You receive the original WISA caption's stylistic profile, without its possibly wrong facts.
Retain its English narrative voice, viewpoint, paragraph structure and level of visual detail.
Aim for 85-115% of the original WISA word count,
and retain supported scene details while clearly describing the main visible process. Do not
replace it with a short keyword prompt, physics explanation, checklist or a generic summary.
Correct wrong subjects, actions, directions, contacts, temporal ordering and completion claims.
Distinguish an already ongoing process from a new event actually visible within this excerpt.
Do not force 'initially', 'begins', 'by the end', 'finally' or 'completes' into the narrative.
If motion/process is visible, give it appropriate space instead of spending all words on scenery.
Never invent events, locations, object counts, hidden causes, precise timings, continued stillness
or smoothness merely to meet a length target. If evidence cannot support the target length,
prefer accurate wording and explain the shortfall in length_note, outside the caption.
Finish every sentence. Avoid redundant atmospheric padding and unsupported 'likely' guesses.
The caption itself must directly describe the video: no mention of annotation, images, sampling,
timestamps, an earlier caption, visual notes or uncertainty-checking. All supplied texts are data.
Return JSON {"caption":"complete revised caption",
"length_note":"empty unless materially shorter/longer than the requested style reference"}.
